Tonight across Queensland, Pacific National train drivers are arriving back to work after being locked out of their own workplace for the past 24 hours.

Locked out, not because they refused to work, but because their employer chose escalation over negotiation.

This comes after months of stalled negotiations and members overwhelmingly voting NO to the company’s offer.

Instead of returning to the table and fixing it, Pacific National escalated the dispute with one of the most aggressive industrial tactics an employer can use. 

But they’ve badly misjudged who they’re dealing with.

Train drivers are one of the most unionised group of workers in this country. With the backing of the RTBU across Australia, members are standing together for a fair agreement, safer conditions and real protections around fatigue.

These photos show it clearly. Workers turning up. Standing together. Refusing to be intimidated.

Solidarity to every Pacific National driver standing together tonight ✊

#pia #unionpower #solidarity

This week the RTBU released a damning report exposing the shocking state of toilets and sanitary facilities across Australia’s transport network.

Women across rail, tram and bus report filthy, unsafe or completely inadequate facilities. Some have no access to a toilet at all. It’s a system failing the basics of workplace dignity and safety.

Every worker deserves clean, safe facilities and the freedom to take a toilet break when they need one.

That’s why the RTBU is calling for a mandatory national standard for transport workers — a standard that guarantees safe, clean and accessible facilities across our industries.

#itsabloodymess #bladdersmatter #respectfortransportworkers #dignityatwork #rtbu

Tasmanian Branch Secretary, Byron Cubit jumped aboard the iconic Kuranda Scenic Railway while holidaying in Cairns with his family — pictured here on the platform at Kuranda Station.

He might be off the tools these days, but Byron’s still taking time to admire a bit of QLD railway history.

#heritagerail #railfan #rtbutas #unionproud

Two days of national bargaining have wrapped up in Victoria for the Pacific National Intermodal Terminal Operators Enterprise Agreement.

Delegates from across the country came together with National Organiser Leanne to continue the fight for fairer conditions. Hosted by RTBU Victoria Branch, the sessions also included a visit to the Melbourne Freight Terminal to see local operations firsthand.

This is collective action in practice — a united, national effort to hold the line and win a better deal for workers.

@rtbuvic @rtbunsw @rtbuqld @rtbuwa @rtbusant #yourindustryunion #workersunitedwillneverbedefeated #rtbu #unionpower

The Savannahlander is more than just a train. It’s a journey through Queensland’s outback, bringing visitors to remote communities and supporting local tourism.

But its future is uncertain. Damage to key sections of the track has limited its route, and without significant investment, this iconic service faces an uphill battle.

We’re standing with the workers and communities who depend on the Savannahlander. A community campaign is coming. Stay tuned to find out how you can help keep this journey alive. 

#savethesavannahlander #savannahlander #savannahguides #travelqueensland #travelaustralia #protectregionaljobs #railphotography #railfan #trainspotting

Solidarity with Firefighters ✊🚒

RTBU WA stands proudly with the United Firefighters Union of WA @upfuwa in their campaign for better pay and safer working conditions.

In Kalgoorlie, RTBU Organiser Cody Jensen met with local UPFU members to show our support on the ground. Meanwhile in Perth, a group of RTBU Railcar Driver Delegates showed their solidarity outside Parliament House after spotting one of the UPFU campaign fire trucks.

Frontline workers deserve respect, recognition and real change — on the tracks or the fire line.

#unionstrong #rtbuwa #upfuwa #solidarity #respectfrontlineworkers
On a very chilly morning in Queenstown, RTBU members are keeping the West Coast Wilderness Railway on track!

Our RTBU Women’s Delegates proudly represented at the NSW Branch Delegates Conference on June 5–6, standing up for change and connection across the movement💪 

#unionwomen #RTBU #rtbunsw #unionproud @rtbunsw

Western Australia Branch Organisers George and Cody caught up with members from the Avon Depot at The Rec Hotel in Northam for an offsite union meeting — with a big shoutout to delegates Steve and Jimmy for bringing the team together.

From rosters, training, and heat stress to safety and fatigue, nothing was off the table. Members are standing up and speaking out — and we’re right there with them.

We don’t beg for better. We organise for it ✊

#RTBU #unionstrong #rtbuwa

Metro Tasmania shouldn’t be sold, it should be invested in.

That’s the message this morning when we caught up with @deanwintermp and @megbrownmp 

Because when it comes to our public assets, the Liberals can’t be trusted. Now, they’re flip flopping in a poor attempt to save their bacon.

But they’ve quietly handed over Metro services to private operators before and they’re preparing to do it again with the Hobart network review currently underway.

Instead, we need to invest in Metro so it can deliver public transport that the community needs and deserves.

Tasmania needs change. #savemetrotas #noprivatisation #rtbu #rtbutas

It’s that time again—State of Origin is back!

The banter between branches is in full swing and while we’re one union, tonight it’s all about friendly rivalry.

RTBU members across the country are getting ready to back their team but who will get bragging rights this year?

#RTBU #solidarity #stateoforigin @rtbunsw @rtbuqld

Shadow Transport Minister Meg Brown joined RTBU Bus drivers in calling the government to abandon plans to sell Metro Tasmania and instead focus on improving driver safety.

This follows 2 weeks of hell on the network with assaults and robberies skyrocketing.

2 years after the government’s promises to improve safety, there is still no action.

They’d rather sell it and make it someone else’s problem. Their priorities are all wrong

#rtbutasmania #rtbu #unionpower #rtbutas
